name: acl
description: Restrict access to an API by allowing or denying consumer groups.

fields.name: allow
fields.label: Allowed Groups (comma separated)
fields.description: Arbitrary group names that are allowed to consume the service.

fields.name: deny
fields.label: Denied Groups (comma separated)
fields.description: Arbitrary group names that are not allowed to consume the service.

fields.name: hide_groups_header
fields.label: Hide Groups Header
fields.description: Whether to hide the X-Consumer-Groups header.
